description: Suggest running lint and tests after edits to code or test files.

rules.description: After editing a .js file under tools/, remind the user to run lint.

action.message: Run `npm run lint` to verify the edited file follows Biome rules.

rules.description: After editing or creating a test file, suggest running the test suite.

action.message: Run `npm test` to confirm the new or updated tests pass (299/299 expected).

rules.description: After editing markdown files, suggest checking links.

action.message: Run `npm run defence:check-md-links` to validate markdown links.
